sourcesContent: // components/Product.tsx import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom' import Button from '../Button' import Tag from '../Tag' import { Card, Descricao, Titulo, Infos, Imagem, Conteudo, Nota, HeaderDescricao } from './styles' import star from '../../assets/images.nova/star.svg' type Props = { title: string description: string infos: string[] image: string nota: number id: number isHome?: boolean } const Product = ({ description, image, infos, title, nota, id, isHome = true }: Props) => { const navigate = useNavigate() const handleNavigate = () => { navigate(`/prato/${id}`) // Navega para a página de detalhes do prato usando o id } return ( {infos.map((info) => ( {info} ))} {title} {nota} {description} ) } export default Product
